# agent-firewall

> Deterministic command pattern firewall, dry-run safety gateway, and cryptographic SHA-256 audit logger for autonomous AI agent tool execution. Zero dependencies.

## Architecture & Security Mechanics

- **Pattern Scanner (`engine/scanner.js`)**: Deterministic AST / Regex matching engine intercepting destructive shell commands (`rm -rf /`, `mkfs`, `dd`), credential harvesting (Cloud IMDS `169.254.169.254`, `~/.ssh`, `.env`), and unvetted pipe execution (`curl | bash`).
- **Policy Engine (`engine/policy.js`)**: Dynamic posture manager evaluating action risk levels (`PERMIT`, `REQUIRE_APPROVAL`, `BLOCK`, `DRY_RUN_ONLY`).
- **Cryptographic Audit Logger (`engine/audit.js`)**: Immutable audit log linking consecutive actions via forward SHA-256 hash chaining ($H_i = \text{SHA-256}(H_{i-1} \parallel \text{Timestamp} \parallel \text{Action})$).

## Public API

```javascript
const { AgentFirewall, PolicyMode } = require('./engine/firewall');

const fw = new AgentFirewall({
  mode: PolicyMode.STRICT_CI,
  logPath: './audit.jsonl'
});

const evaluation = fw.evaluateCommand('curl http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/');
// Result: { allowed: false, reason: 'Cloud IMDS credential exfiltration blocked', ruleId: 'SEC-003' }
```

## Reproducible Test Suite

- `node tests/firewall.test.js`: 9/9 automated tests verifying security rules and documenting known edge cases (e.g. base64 payload obfuscation).
